remarks: Spanning over 1,000 sq. ft., this spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath ranch-style home offers comfort and convenience The open layout is complemented by abundant closet space, new kitchen appliances, and an easy flow for today's living. Enjoy sunny beach days, strolls, jogging, or even roller skating along its flat scenic trails. This well-maintained complex reflects pride of ownership, with a recently completed roof replacement through a special assessment. Few units ever become available here! Additional highlights include: Two reserved covered parking space, Washer/dryer conveniently located just steps from your unit and sepearate in building storage.
